This post walks through my first contribution to #TidyTuesday, a weekly data project aimed at the R ecosystem.

#TidyTuesday is a great way to practice data wrangling and visualization skills with real-world datasets. Each week, a new dataset is posted along with a chart or article related to that data.

::: {.callout-note}
#TidyTuesday provides an excellent opportunity to practice R skills and connect with the R community. Check out the [TidyTuesday repository](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday) for more information.
:::
